info.description: Hold the coin, get paid in stocks. The Index turns trading activity into real stock ownership. Every time $INDEX is traded, a 3% fee is collected in ETH and used to buy a basket of 18 tokenized stocks on Robinhood Chain. Those stocks are sent straight to holders' wallets — automatically, onchain, every 15 minutes. No claiming, no staking. The more the coin is traded, the more stocks the community owns.

Ignition is a launchpad on Robinhood Chain, and the whole idea behind it is that a token shouldn’t be stuck the way it launched. On most platforms you deploy once and that’s it, it’s frozen forever. On Ignition you can keep working on a token after it’s live, so you can rename it, change its tier, or upgrade how its fees work, all while keeping the exact same contract, the same holders and the same liquidity. Ravenhood is a deflationary token protocol built on Robinhood Chain. The project is centered on RVH, a fixed-supply ERC-20 token with protocol mechanics  designed around supply reduction, liquidity locking, and treasury development. Ravenhood uses permissionless burn mechanics that allow eligible protocol  actions to permanently remove tokens from circulation. The project also includes a website, swap interface, staking interface, burn dashboard, mindshare  system, and protocol documentation for users to follow token activity and ecosystem updates.

Bundlecat (BUN) is the first token launched on Mosh, a token launch protocol developed by UV Labs and deployed on Robinhood Chain. Mosh pairs new token launches with autonomous AI market-making agents. Under the Mosh model, token bundles are crowd-funded by participants and permanently locked in non-custodial smart contract vaults at the moment of launch. AI agents then use the locked tokens to provide liquidity and generate buy-side market activity, operating within contract-enforced rules that no individual, including the Mosh team, can override. Raeto is an app on Robinhood Chain that pays for AI with the interest your assets earn. Deposit tokenized stocks or USDG into Raeto vaults, which lend through Morpho; the interest becomes AI credits for 400+ models, while you keep your deposit. Auto routing sends each request to the cheapest model that can handle it, and rCREDIT turns AI credits into a token backed 1:1 by USDG. Raeto supports autonomous AI agents. An agent can sign in with its own wallet to receive an API key, or pay per request onchain using USDG or rCREDIT, without a human-managed account.
